Crescent Park Management LP Has Trimmed Its Stake in Facebook (FB) by $5.67 Million as Stock Price Declined; Herbalife LTD (HLF) Shareholder Aristeia Capital Increased Position by $5.46 Million as Valuation Rose
May 29, 2018 - By Gary Bell
Crescent Park Management Lp decreased its stake in Facebook Inc (FB) by 16% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Crescent Park Management Lp sold 35,660 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.01% with the market. The institutional investor held 187,215 shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $29.92M, down from 222,875 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Crescent Park Management Lp who had been investing in Facebook Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $537.04 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.33% or $0.61 $185.53. About 6.39 million shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 21.69% uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.12% the S&P500.
Robert Henry Lynch increased its stake in Herbalife Ltd (HLF) by 444.11% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Aristeia Capital Llc bought 56,286 shares as the company’s stock rose 12.86% while stock markets declined.
